αἰδοίῃς: αἰδοῖος — revered, venerable; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃς (= Attic -αῖς)
αἱ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. nom. pl. ’they’, referring to the ships (αἱ δ’ ... ἔπλεον) · also fem. nom. pl. ’they’, of women (αἱ δ’ ὅτε ... ἵκοντο ’and when they came’) · also fem. nom. pl. ’they’, of the mules (αἱ δ’ ὦκα λίπον ’and they quickly left’) · also fem. nom. pl. ’they’, of the islands (αἱ δέ τ’ ἄνευθε ’and they lie apart’) · also fem. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the others’ (αἱ ἄλλαι ’the other ships’) · also fem. nom. pl., correlative, of the doors: αἱ μὲν … αἱ δ’ ’the one … the other’ · also fem. nom. pl. ’they’, of the swine (αἱ δὲ νέμονται ’and they graze’) · also fem. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (αἱ κύνες ’the dogs’) · also fem. nom. pl., correlative, of the maids: αἱ μὲν … αἱ δ’ ’some … others’, in orders ’some of you … others of you’ · also fem. nom. pl. ’they’, of the cattle (αἱ μὲν γίγνονται ’they grow’) · also fem. nom. pl., correlative, of the Achaean women: αἱ μὲν … αἱ δ’ ’some … others’ · also fem. nom. pl. ’they’, of the souls of the dead
γυναιξὶν: γυνή — woman; fem. dat. pl., epic -ξιν (ν-movable), grave mid-clause form
δεδμημένοι: δάμνημι (δαμάζω) — overpower, subdue, tame; perf. part. pass. masc. nom. pl.: ’overpowered’
δμῳῇσι: δμῳή — female slave, handmaid; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇσι (= Attic -αις)
δώδεκ: δώδεκα — twelve; numeral, indeclinable, elided (δώδεκ’ = δώδεκα)
εἰπόντος: εἶπον — say; aor. part. masc. gen. sg., agreeing with a noun: ’as he said’
εὐπατέρειαν: εὐπατέρεια — daughter of a good father, well-fathered; fem. acc. sg., epithet of Tyro
εὐχετάασθαι: εὐχετάομαι — vaunt, exult over, boast; pres. inf. mid./dep., epic uncontracted (= Attic εὐχετᾶσθαι)
θέε: θέω — run; impf. 3 sg., uncontracted and unaugmented (= Attic ἔθει): ’ran’
θρασὺν: θρασύς — bold, daring; adj., masc. acc. sg.
θύγατρες: θυγάτηρ — daughter; fem. nom. pl., epic (= Attic θυγατέρες)
θὲς: τίθημι — put, place; aor. imper. 2 sg.: ’put!’
κέκλετο: κέλομαι — call on, bid, urge; aor. 3 sg., reduplicated, unaugmented: ’called on’
καλέσσω: καλέω — call, summon; aor. subj. 1 sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic καλέσω), in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that I may summon’
καλλιπάρῃος: καλλιπάρῃος — fair-cheeked; adj. (2-term.), fem. nom. sg., epic -ῃος, from παρῃά ’cheek’ (Attic παρειά); epithet of Helen · also epithet of the maid Melantho
κατεβήσετο: καταβαίνω — go down, descend; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= κατέβη)
καὐτὸς: καὶ αὐτός (crasis καὐτός) — and...yourself, even yourself; masc. nom. sg.: ‘you yourself too’
κεῖνόν: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖνος); masc. acc. sg. (accented on the ultima before the enclitic γ’)
κηώεντα: κηώεις — fragrant (traditional gloss, origin uncertain); masc. acc. sg., agreeing with θάλαμον
κουράων: κούρη — girl, maiden; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic κορῶν)
κούρῃ: κούρη — girl, maiden, daughter (Attic κόρη); dat. sg.
λίθοιο: λίθος — stone; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
λύθρῳ: λύθρον — gore, defiling filth; neut. dat. sg.
μέγαρ: μέγαρον — hall; neut. acc. pl., elided (μέγαρ’ = μέγαρα), plural for a single house
μαρνάμενοι: μάρναμαι — fight; pres. part. mid./dep. masc. nom. pl.: ’fighting’
μελίφρονα: μελίφρων — honey-hearted, sweet to the heart; masc. acc. sg., epithet of wine
μελιηδέα: μελιηδής — honey-sweet; fem. acc. sg., uncontracted (adj. of two endings) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a masc. noun (μελιηδέα καρπόν ’honey-sweet fruit’)
νείατος: νείατος (= νέατος) — undermost, last, lowest; adj., masc. nom. sg., epic νει- (= νέατος), + gen.: ’lowest of the others’
ξεστῇς: ξεστός — polished, smoothed; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇς (= Attic ξεσταῖς)
πάροιθε: πάροιθε — in front, before; adv. of place · also of time: ’formerly, before’ (τὸ πάροιθε)
παῖδάς: παῖς — child, son; masc. acc. pl., accented before the enclitic τε
πεπαλαγμένον: παλάσσω — splash, smear, defile; perf. mid./pass. part. neut. acc. sg.: ’smeared’ (with grime) · also masc. acc. sg., of a person: ’smeared’ (αἵματι καὶ λύθρῳ πεπαλαγμένον ’smeared with blood and gore’)
ποικίλμασιν: ποίκιλμα — piece of embroidery, variegated work; neut. dat. pl., with movable ν, dat. of respect: ’in embroideries’
πῃ: πῃ — in some way, anywhere; enclitic adv.
σιδονίων: Σιδόνιος — Sidonian, of Sidon (Phoenician city); adj./noun, masc. gen. pl.: ’of the Sidonians’
σοῖσιν: σός — your, yours; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν
σπείσῃς: σπένδω — pour a libation; aor. subj. 2 sg.
τέκτονες: τέκτων — builder, carpenter, shipwright; masc. nom. pl.
τετυγμένον: τεύχω — make, fashion, construct; perf. pass. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’wrought, well-made’
τῇσι: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic ταῖς): ’among them’ · also fem. dat. pl. of possession or interest: ’their’ (τῇσι τοκῆας φθῖσαν θεοί ’the gods destroyed their parents’)
φαίην: φημί — say; pres. opt. 1 sg. act., potential with κε: ‘I would say’
φθινύθουσι: φθινύθω — waste away, wither; pres. 3 pl.
φρέν: φρήν — mind, heart, wits; fem. acc. sg., elided (φρέν’ = φρένα), accusative of respect: ’in heart’
φωνήσαντε: φωνέω — raise the voice, speak; aor. part. masc. nom. dual
φῦ: φύω — grow, put forth; mid. sense ’took firm hold of, clasped’; aor. 3 sg. (root aorist), tmesis with ἐν (ἔν … φῦ = ἐνέφυ)
χρύσεα: χρύσεος — golden; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic χρυσᾶ)
χρύσεος: χρύσεος — golden; masc. nom. sg., uncontracted (= Attic χρυσοῦς)
ἀέξει: ἀέξω — make grow, increase (Attic αὐξάνω); pres. 3 sg.
ἀγελείης: ἀγελείη — driver of spoil, spoil-bringer (epithet of Athena); fem. gen. sg., epic (= ἀγελείας)
ἀειραμένη: ἀείρω (= αἴρω) — lift, raise, take up; aor. part. mid., fem. nom. sg., epic uncontracted: ’having taken up’
ἀλόχοισιν: ἄλοχος — wife; fem. dat. pl., epic -οισιν, dative of comparison: ’like (to) the wives’ · also fem. dat. pl. after παρά: ’beside (their) wives’ (παρ’ αἰδοίῃς ἀλόχοισιν)
ἀμφιπόλοισι: ἀμφίπολος — handmaid, attendant; fem. dat. pl., epic -οισι
ἀμύνων: ἀμύνω — ward off, defend; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., ’keeping off (a harm) from (dat.)’
ἀνένευε: ἀνανεύω — throw back the head, nod ’no’, refuse by a sign; impf. 3 sg., augment inside the compound (ἀν-έ-νευε)
ἀνήγαγεν: ἀνάγω — lead up, bring up; aor. 3 sg.: ‘he led up’
ἀπέλαμπεν: ἀπολάμπω — shine forth, gleam; impf. 3 sg. act.: ’was gleaming’
ἀϋτή: ἀϋτή — war-cry, shout, din; fem. nom. sg.
ἄκρης: ἄκρη — top, peak, crest; fem. gen. sg., + κατά: ’down from the top’, of a wave breaking from its crest · also gen. with ἐπί: ’on, to the height’ (ἐρύσαντας ἐπ’ ἄκρης ’having dragged it to the top’)
ἐθέλῃσ: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. subj. 3 sg., elided (ἐθέλῃσ’ = ἐθέλῃσι): ’he is willing’
ἐναντίη: ἐναντίος — opposite, face to face; fem. nom. sg., predicative: ’face to face, openly’
ἐνείκω: φέρω — bring, carry; aor. subj. 1 sg., epic ἐνείκ- (= Attic ἐνέγκω): ’let me bring’
ἐφῆπτο: ἐφάπτω — fasten upon; plpf. pass. 3 sg., + dat.: ’was fastened upon’
ἔθηκαν: τίθημι — put, place, set; aor. 3 pl., built like the sg. ἔθηκε rather than the root-aorist (= Attic ἔθεσαν) · also ’made (them so)’, with a predicate acc. (ἔθηκαν ἀνόστους ’made them without return’)
ἔνδοθεν: ἔνδοθεν — from within, within; adv., -θεν suffix of place
ἔνεσαν: ἔνειμι — be in, be within; impf. 3 pl., epic ἔσαν (= Attic ἐνῆσαν): ’were in it’
ἔρχεο: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. imper. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔρχου)
ἔρχευ: ἔρχομαι — go, come; imper. 2 sg., epic ἔρχευ (= Attic ἔρχου)
ἔστιν: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., impersonal: ’it is possible’ · also plain copula, personal: ’is’ (ἀργύρεος ... ἔστιν ἅπας ’it is entirely silver’) · also with a dat. of the possessor, ’have’ (ἅσσα μοι ἔστιν ’whatever I have’) · also existential, ’there is’ (ἐν … νηὶ … βρῶσίς τε πόσις τε ἔστιν ’in the ship there is food and drink’)
ἕν: εἷς, μία, ἕν — one; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἤγαγε: ἄγω — lead, bring; aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’led, brought’
ἱερεύσομεν: ἱερεύω — sacrifice, slaughter; fut. or short-vowel aor. subj. 1 pl.: ’we shall sacrifice’
ἴδοιμι: ὁράω — see; aor. 2 opt. 1 sg. (from εἶδον), in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’that I might see’ · also after εἴ πως, of an aim in view: ’(to see) if somehow I might see’
ὀϊζύος: ὀϊζύς — woe, misery; fem. gen. sg., epic
